SELECT la.title,
       la.sale_price,
       la.condition,
       la.listed_on,
       ms.name AS spot_name
FROM nlq.listings_all la
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON la.spot_id = ms.spot_id
WHERE la.is_for_sale = true
  AND la.status = 'available'
  AND (la.title ILIKE '%laptop%' OR la.description ILIKE '%laptop%')
ORDER BY la.listed_on DESC
